_comment: INTERNAL PROMOTION, not an external application. Two things follow from that.
First, the package contains BOTH CVs. The biosketch (assets/biosketch.pdf) is the complete
scientific record and is never tailored — docs/APPLICATIONS.md, and it is the document a
promotion committee actually reads. This manifest produces the SECOND document: a one-page
digest whose bullets are labelled by the §9B criterion each one answers, so the committee
can map the record onto the policy without doing the mapping themselves.
Second, everything here is scoped to the Woodwell period (Jan 2022 onward). The five
publications selected are all Woodwell-era; four are first-author. Career-total figures —
20 publications, 291 citations, 17 invited talks — are NOT used anywhere, because they
include pre-Woodwell work and a promotion argues performance in the current position.
KNOWN GAP: Section 5's organizational engagement metrics (timecards, expense reports,
KnowBe4, subordinate performance reviews) have no support in the data layer and nothing
here claims them. Named openly in letter.json ¶8.

meta.note: Internal promotion, Research Scientist I → II, under the Research Staff Promotion Policy (eff. 15 Apr 2026), §9B criteria. Cycle/deadline unresolved — the policy's deadline table did not survive the paste; see job.md archive note 1.

_comment_publications: Three first-author journal articles, deliberately. yang2026circumpolar (the Arctic Data
Center release) is NOT listed here even though it is the flagship output — its title runs
to ~230 characters, roughly three lines of the right-hand column, and the same claim is
already made by the 'Create Knowledge' experience bullet. Nothing is lost but the space.
The right column is a minipage and CANNOT break across pages, so every character here is
taken from Experience, Awards or Collaborations. The canonical one-pager carries no
publications block at all; this variant adds one, and has to pay for it elsewhere.
